name: Creator-canon 2D visual system
character_design_authority: Creator-provided character artwork is authoritative. AI must preserve the established character designs and must not redesign characters.
positive_anchors: match attached approved creator-provided character artwork exactly
preserve official silhouette, anatomy, proportions, features, markings, colors, clothing, accessories, hands, feet, and relative scale
preserve the line, shape, texture, and color treatment demonstrated by approved creator artwork
expressive acting within approved character construction
bare feet or uncovered natural bare paws on every visible character

camera_language.comedy: Prefer readable wide and medium frames with clear anticipation, trajectory, and background reactions.
camera_language.emotion: Move closer and simplify motion at the turn; hold long enough for a genuine reaction.
camera_language.action: Maintain screen direction and geography; one dominant action per shot.
camera_language.ending: Finish on a simple, quickly readable image or reaction rather than an abrupt dialogue cutoff.

continuity_rules: Resolve character reference images from assets/asset-manifest.json before generation.
Only creator source artwork approved for provider use and approved canon references may control character identity.
AI-generated test material is non-canon and cannot serve as a character identity reference.
Block generation when required official reference coverage is missing; never invent an unseen view.
Track prop hand, stains, damage, weather, light direction, and entrances/exits between shots.
Do not add clothing or accessories absent from creator-approved references.
Every prompt repeats the barefoot positive and footwear negative lock.

delivery_defaults.frame_rate_note: Choose final delivery frame rate during production; do not bake a provider-specific setting into canon.
